title: Quintessential Herbal American Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring brandy and a mirepoix base, perfect for a cold winter's night or as a hangover cure. This dish is nut-free and cooked to perfection in a claypot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken thighs with salt and black pepper.
Heat the claypot over medium heat and sear the chicken thighs until browned on all sides.
Add the brandy to the claypot and ignite, letting the flames cook for 30 seconds.
Add the sliced onions, carrots, and celery to the claypot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the minced garlic, thyme, and rosemary to the claypot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the claypot and bring to a boil.
Cover the claypot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs.
